data.exact_reserve_text: In the calendar year there was a prior accident year favourable development of claims incurred of $1.1m. (2014: $6.6m).
data.standardized_narrative: At 1 January 2015 gross claims outstanding were $121.265m. Analysis of the gross claims development triangle indicates a net prior-year strengthening of approximately $7.95m (c.6.6% of opening gross reserves), driven by adverse development in the 2013 underwriting year partly offset by releases in older years (2011 and 2012). The movement was calculated from the syndicate's gross claims development table as no single explicit gross prior-year movement line was provided.
raw_causal_phrases: prior accident year favourable development of claims incurred of $1.1m. (2014: $6.6m).
data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding and the gross claims development triangle were taken from Note 17 and Note 18 (Technical provisions / Claims development). There is no explicit single-line gross 'movement in prior year's provision' figure; prior-year development was calculated from the gross claims development triangle (excluded the two most recent underwriting years per methodology). Reported monetary amounts are in the report's native currency (USD). The document also reports a small net favourable prior-accident-year claims incurred amount ($1.1m) which is a different P&L metric; the gross PYD used here is derived from the triangle.
